description.value: SkyTrek Adventure Park is a family-oriented outdoor adventure park situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway (Highway 1), roughly 32 km west of Revelstoke and 35 km east of Sicamous — a busy touring corridor. The park features a treetop Sky Course with over 30 aerial elements, zip lines, an adventure tower, and kids' zones, and shares its site with the well-known Enchanted Forest attraction. Its highway-accessible location makes it a natural mid-route stop for cyclists riding between Sicamous and Revelstoke.
